Aries.blurb: Initiating fire — courageous, competitive, quick to act, loves a fresh start.

Taurus.blurb: Grounded earth — patient, pleasure-loving, security-seeking, immovable once settled.

Gemini.blurb: Quick air — communicative, playful, endlessly curious, easily bored.

Cancer.blurb: Tender water — caring, intuitive, home-loving, guards a soft heart with a shell.

Leo.blurb: Radiant fire — confident, big-hearted, loves to shine and be appreciated.

Virgo.blurb: Discerning earth — practical, detail-loving, of service, hard on themselves.

Libra.blurb: Relational air — seeks balance, beauty, and partnership; weighs every side.

Scorpio.blurb: Profound water — passionate, perceptive, all-or-nothing, transforms through depth.

Sagittarius.blurb: Expansive fire — freedom-loving, truth-seeking, restless for the next horizon.

Capricorn.blurb: Building earth — patient climber, pragmatic, takes the long view, quietly devoted.

Aquarius.blurb: Visionary air — inventive, principled, future-minded, marches to its own drum.

Pisces.blurb: Boundless water — empathic, artistic, spiritual, dissolves the line between self and other.

planets.Sun: core identity, ego, vitality, how you shine
planets.Moon: emotions, inner needs, instincts, what makes you feel safe
planets.Mercury: mind, communication, how you think and speak
planets.Venus: love, attraction, values, how you relate and what you find beautiful
planets.Mars: drive, desire, anger, how you assert and pursue
planets.Jupiter: growth, luck, beliefs, where you expand
planets.Saturn: discipline, limits, responsibility, where you mature the hard way
planets.Uranus: change, rebellion, originality, where you break the mold
planets.Neptune: dreams, intuition, illusion, where boundaries dissolve
planets.Pluto: power, transformation, the depths, where you're reborn
planets.Ascendant: the rising sign — your outward style, first impression, the mask you meet the world with
planets.Descendant: what you seek in a partner; the qualities you're drawn to in others
planets.Medium_Coeli: the Midheaven — public role, career, reputation, aspiration
planets.Mean_Node: the lunar north node — your growth direction in this life

aspects.conjunction: 0° — fusion; the two planets blend and intensify each other
aspects.sextile: 60° — easy opportunity; gifts that flow with a little effort
aspects.square: 90° — tension that drives growth; friction demanding action
aspects.trine: 120° — natural harmony and talent; easy, sometimes taken for granted
aspects.opposition: 180° — polarity; a push-pull seeking balance, often via others
aspects.quincunx: 150° — awkward adjustment; two energies that don't quite fit

notes: Element balance (fire/earth/air/water) and modality balance (cardinal/fixed/mutable) are tallied across the ten planets. A dominant or missing element/modality colors the whole temperament.
